}</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “CSS rules that apply to the current document.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;style&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;s&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;optgroup&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;header&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6579">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6580 / 8000 · Practice 29</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6581">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6581" data-page="6581" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5704"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 29</span><span>Page 6581 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5704 — s × margin-top</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">s</span> <span class="badge prop">margin-top</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">margin-top</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;s&gt;</code> — marks text that is no longer accurate or relevant (not a strikethrough for style). Shorthand: width + style + color for the whole border.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dfn&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px"><dfn style="font-style:italic"><b>semantics</b></dfn>: the meaning carried by markup, not just its appearance.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;&lt;dfn&gt;semantics&lt;/dfn&gt;: the meaning of markup.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>border</b> = <b>1px solid #d1d5db</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dfn { border: 1px solid #d1d5db; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A thematic grouping of content, typically with a heading.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;data&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;output&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;h1&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;section&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6581">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6582 / 8000 · Practice 29</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6583">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6583" data-page="6583" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5706"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 29</span><span>Page 6583 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5706 — sup × clear</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">sup</span> <span class="badge prop">clear</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">clear</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;sup&gt;</code> — superscript text (rendered above the baseline). Prevents floats on one or both sides (moves the box below them).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;sup&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">E = mc<sup>2</sup></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;E = mc&lt;sup&gt;2&lt;/sup&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>clear</b> = <b>both</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>sup { clear: both; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A major block of navigation links.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;kbd&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;nav&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;colgroup&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;h4&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6582">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6583 / 8000 · Practice 29</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6584">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6584" data-page="6584" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5707"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 29</span><span>Page 6584 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5707 — ol × content-visibility</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">ol</span> <span class="badge prop">content-visibility</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">content-visibility</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;ol&gt;</code> — a numbered list of items. Skip rendering of off-screen subtrees (auto + contain-intrinsic-size).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;ol&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><ol start="2" style="font-size:13px;margin:0;padding-left:22px;line-height:1.7"><li>Second step</li><li>Third step</li></ol></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ol start=&quot;2&quot;&gt; &lt;li&gt;Second step&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Third step&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ol&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>content-visibility</b> = <b>visible</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>ol { content-visibility: visible; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “The dominant, unique content of the document.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;var&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;main&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;tbody&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;p&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6583">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6584 / 8000 · Practice 29</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6585">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6585" data-page="6585" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5708"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 29</span><span>Page 6585 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5708 — source × flex-grow</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">source</span> <span class="badge prop">flex-grow</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">flex-grow</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;source&gt;</code> — a candidate resource for &lt;video&gt;, &lt;audio&gt; or &lt;picture&gt;. How much an item grows to fill spare space (ratio).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;source&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;background:#f6f8fa;border:1px solid #d0d7de;border-radius:6px;padding:8px">1) movie.webm ✓ plays<br>2) movie.mp4 (fallback, skipped)</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;video controls&gt; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A section heading of importance level 3 (h1 = highest).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;bdi&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;center&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;details&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;h3&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6585">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6586 / 8000 · Practice 29</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6587">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6587" data-page="6587" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5710"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 29</span><span>Page 6587 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5710 — input × font-weight</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">input</span> <span class="badge prop">font-weight</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-weight</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;input&gt;</code> — the most versatile form control: text, email, number, date, file, checkbox, radio, range, color, search and more. The thickness of the text (100–900 or keywords).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;input&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><form style="display:grid;gap:8px;font-size:12px;max-width:250px"><label style="display:grid;gap:3px"><b>Full name</b><input style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px"></label><label style="display:grid;gap:3px"><b>Email</b><input type="email" style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px"></label><label style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center"><input type="checkbox" checked> Newsletter</label><button style="justify-self:start;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 16px">Send</button></form></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;form&gt; &lt;label&gt;Full name &lt;input type=&quot;text&quot; name=&quot;name&quot; required autocomplete=&quot;name&quot;&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;Email &lt;input type=&quot;email&quot; name=&quot;email&quot; required&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;Age &lt;input type=&quot;number&quot; name=&quot;age&quot; min=&quot;0&quot; max=&quot;120&quot;&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;&lt;input type=&quot;checkbox&quot; name=&quot;news&quot; checked&gt; Newsletter&lt;/label&gt; &lt;button&gt;Send&lt;/button&gt; &lt;/form&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font-weight</b> = <b>100–900</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>input { font-weight: 100–900; Alignment of the last line (matters with justify).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;label&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;max-width:230px"><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center"><span style="font-weight:600">Email address</span><input style="flex:1;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px"></div><div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-top:8px"><input type="checkbox" checked> <span>Accept terms (wrapped label — click the text to toggle)</span></div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;label for=&quot;email&quot;&gt;Email address&lt;/label&gt; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A single line break (forced newline) in the text.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;dt&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;acronym&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;br&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;i&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6587">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6588 / 8000 · Practice 29</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6589">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6589" data-page="6589" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5712"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 29</span><span>Page 6589 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5712 — col × hyphens</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">col</span> <span class="badge prop">hyphens</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">hyphens</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;col&gt;</code> — defines a single column inside a &lt;colgroup&gt; (for styling). Automatic hyphenation of long words.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;col&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="display:flex;font-size:10px;height:26px"><div style="flex:1;border:1px solid #d1d5db">1</div><div style="flex:1;border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#eef2ff">2</div><div style="flex:1;border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#eef2ff">3</div><div style="flex:1;border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#eef2ff">4</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;colgroup&gt;&lt;col span=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&lt;col span=&quot;3&quot; style=&quot;background:#eef2ff&quot;&gt;&lt;/colgroup&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>hyphens</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>col { hyphens: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A section quoted from another source.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;picture&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;blockquote&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;noframes&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;s&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6588">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6589 / 8000 · Practice 29</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6590">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6590" data-page="6590" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5713"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 29</span><span>Page 6590 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5713 — font × background-position</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">font</span> <span class="badge prop">background-position</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background-position</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;font&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: font (obsolete). Where the background image sits.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;font&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="font-family:serif;color:#ef4444;font-size:13px">Legacy: <font> is dead — use CSS</span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;font face=&quot;Arial&quot; color=&quot;red&quot;&gt;text&lt;/font&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>background-position</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>font { background-position: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A native dialog box: modal when shown with showModal(), non-modal when shown with show().”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;audio&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;isindex&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;dialog&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;cite&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6589">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6590 / 8000 · Practice 29</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6591">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6591" data-page="6591" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5714"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 29</span><span>Page 6591 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5714 — acronym × backdrop-filter</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">acronym</span> <span class="badge prop">backdrop-filter</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">backdrop-filter</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;acronym&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: acronym (obsolete). → "hi"</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;script src=&quot;app.js&quot; defer&gt;&lt;/script&gt; &lt;script&gt; console.log(&quot;hi&quot;); &lt;/script&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>transition-delay</b> = <b>time</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>script { transition-delay: time; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “An abbreviation or acronym, with its expansion in the title attribute.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;input&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;link&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;abbr&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;ruby&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6593">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6594 / 8000 · Practice 29</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6595">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6595" data-page="6595" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5718"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 29</span><span>Page 6595 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5718 — aside × transform</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">aside</span> <span class="badge prop">transform</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">transform</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;aside&gt;</code> — content tangentially related to the main content (sidebar, box, pull quote). Move/rotate/scale/skew the element (GPU-friendly, doesn&#x27;t reflow).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;aside&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="background:#fff3e0;border:1px solid #ffcc80;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;width:230px"><b style="font-size:12px">Did you know?</b><br><span style="font-size:12px">An <b>aside</b> box — related but optional.</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;aside&gt; &lt;h3&gt;Did you know?&lt;/h3&gt; &lt;p&gt;HTML5 added 40+ new elements.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/aside&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>transform</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>aside { transform: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A machine-readable date, time, or duration (calendar integration).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;option&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;time&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;script&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;bdi&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6594">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6595 / 8000 · Practice 29</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6596">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6596" data-page="6596" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5719"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 29</span><span>Page 6596 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5719 — figcaption × height</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">figcaption</span> <span class="badge prop">height</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">height</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;figcaption&gt;</code> — the caption for a &lt;figure&gt;. The browser adds vertical space around it automatically.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;This is a paragraph of text.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding</b> = <b>12px</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>p { padding: 12px; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Superscript text (rendered above the baseline).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;sup&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;legend&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;article&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;dt&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6596">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6597 / 8000 · Practice 29</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6598">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6598" data-page="6598" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5721"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 29</span><span>Page 6598 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5721 — summary × border-radius</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">summary</span> <span class="badge prop">border-radius</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border-radius</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;summary&gt;</code> — the visible caption of a &lt;details&gt; disclosure. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Independent scale (composes with transform).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>clear</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>scale</code></li><li>C. <code>font-stretch</code></li><li>D. <code>shape-outside</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6685">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6686 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6687">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6687" data-page="6687" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5810"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6687 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5810 — h2 × transition-property</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">h2</span> <span class="badge prop">transition-property</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">transition-property</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;h2&gt;</code> — a section heading of importance level 2 (h1 = highest). Which properties transition (list).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;h2&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-weight:700;font-size:21.0px;line-height:1.25;margin:2px 0">Heading level 2</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;h2&gt;Heading level 2&lt;/h2&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>transition-property</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>h2 { transition-property: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Position along the offset-path (0%–100%).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>bottom</code></li><li>B. <code>font-optical-sizing</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>offset-distance</code></li><li>D. <code>list-style-type</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6686">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6687 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6688">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6688" data-page="6688" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5811"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6688 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5811 — br × animation-timeline</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">br</span> <span class="badge prop">animation-timeline</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">animation-timeline</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;br&gt;</code> — a single line break (forced newline) in the text. Drive an animation from a scroll position (new).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;br&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;background:#fafbfc;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:8px;border-radius:6px">12 Main St.<br>Cairo, Egypt<br>12611</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;address&gt;12 Main St.&lt;br&gt;Cairo, Egypt&lt;br&gt;12611&lt;/address&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>animation-timeline</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>br { animation-timeline: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches by tag name (p, a, h1…).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>element</code></li><li>B. <code>:focus-visible</code></li><li>C. <code>:last-of-type</code></li><li>D. <code>:placeholder-shown</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6687">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6688 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6689">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6689" data-page="6689" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5812"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6689 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5812 — span × display</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">span</span> <span class="badge prop">display</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">display</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;span&gt;</code> — a neutral inline container with no meaning. Sets how an element participates in layout: block, inline, flex, grid, none…</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;span&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Total: <span style="color:#16a34a;font-weight:700">$49</span> <span style="color:#9ca3af;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11px">$60</span></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Total: &lt;span class=&quot;price&quot;&gt;$49&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>display</b> = <b>inline</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>span { display: inline; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches elements that HAVE the attribute.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>B. <code>:last-child</code></li><li>C. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li><li>D. <code>:lang(code)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6688">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6689 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6690">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6690" data-page="6690" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5813"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6690 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5813 — small × margin-left</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">small</span> <span class="badge prop">margin-left</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">margin-left</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;small&gt;</code> — side comments and small print: fine print, copyrights, legal notes. Distance to the left of the element.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;small&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Offer ends Friday. <small style="font-size:11px;color:#6b7280">T&amp;Cs apply.</small></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Offer ends Friday. &lt;small&gt;T&amp;Cs apply.&lt;/small&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>margin-left</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>small { margin-left: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The value ends with the string.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:nth-of-type(n)</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>[attr$=…]</code></li><li>C. <code>:checked</code></li><li>D. <code>descendant (space)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6689">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6690 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6691">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6691" data-page="6691" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5814"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6691 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5814 — time × border-color</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">time</span> <span class="badge prop">border-color</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border-color</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;time&gt;</code> — a machine-readable date, time, or duration (calendar integration). Border color on all sides (1–4 values).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;time&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Published <time datetime="2026-09-16" style="color:#1a56db;font-weight:600">16 September 2026</time></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;time datetime=&quot;2026-09-16&quot;&gt;16 September 2026&lt;/time&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>border-color</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>time { border-color: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The element is under the pointer.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:empty</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:hover</code></li><li>C. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li><li>D. <code>::before</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6690">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6691 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6692">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6692" data-page="6692" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5815"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6692 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5815 — ruby × bottom</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">ruby</span> <span class="badge prop">bottom</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">bottom</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;ruby&gt;</code> — japanese/chinese pinyin-style pronunciation annotation. Vertical offset from the bottom.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;ruby&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;font-family:serif"><ruby>中<rt style="font-size:9px">zhōng</rt></ruby>国<rp>(</rp><rt style="font-size:9px">guó</rt><rp>)</rp></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ruby&gt;中&lt;rt&gt;zhōng&lt;/rt&gt;&lt;/ruby&gt;&lt;ruby&gt;国&lt;rt&gt;guó&lt;/rt&gt;&lt;/ruby&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>bottom</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>ruby { bottom: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The element is being pressed/clicked.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:where(sel, …)</code></li><li>B. <code>:target</code></li><li>C. <code>::first-line</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:active</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6691">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6692 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6693">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6693" data-page="6693" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5816"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6693 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5816 — li × perspective</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">li</span> <span class="badge prop">perspective</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">perspective</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;li&gt;</code> — a single item inside &lt;ul&gt;, &lt;ol&gt; or &lt;menu&gt;. How strong the 3D effect looks (distance of the viewer&#x27;s eye).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;li&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><ol style="font-size:13px;margin:0;padding-left:22px;line-height:1.7"><li>Start</li><li value="10">Jumps to 10</li><li>Then 11</li></ol></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ol&gt; &lt;li&gt;Start&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li value=&quot;10&quot;&gt;Jumps to 10&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Then 11&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ol&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>perspective</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>li { perspective: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The sole child of its parent.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:enabled / :disabled</code></li><li>B. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>::marker</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:only-child</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6692">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6693 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6694">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6694" data-page="6694" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5817"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6694 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5817 — video × flex</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">video</span> <span class="badge prop">flex</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">flex</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;video&gt;</code> — embeds a video player with optional controls, autoplay, loop and captions. Shorthand: flex-grow flex-shrink flex-basis.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;video&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="width:230px;height:120px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a5f,#0f172a);border-radius:8px;position:relative"><span style="position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center"><span style="width:0;height:0;border-left:22px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);border-top:14px solid transparent;border-bottom:14px solid transparent"></span></span><span style="position:absolute;bottom:6px;left:8px;font-size:10px;color:#e5e7eb">▶ clip.mp4 — controls</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;video controls width=&quot;320&quot; poster=&quot;thumb.jpg&quot;&gt; &lt;source src=&quot;clip.webm&quot; type=&quot;video/webm&quot;&gt; &lt;source src=&quot;clip.mp4&quot; type=&quot;video/mp4&quot;&gt; &lt;track kind=&quot;captions&quot; src=&quot;en.vtt&quot; srclang=&quot;en&quot; label=&quot;EN&quot;&gt; &lt;/video&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>flex</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>video { flex: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “First of its tag among siblings.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:placeholder-shown</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:first-of-type</code></li><li>C. <code>~</code></li><li>D. <code>::cue</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6693">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6694 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6695">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6695" data-page="6695" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5818"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6695 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5818 — embed × grid-auto-rows</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">embed</span> <span class="badge prop">grid-auto-rows</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">grid-auto-rows</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;embed&gt;</code> — embeds an external application (legacy plugin interface). Size of implicitly created rows.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;embed&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;width:220px;padding:10px;background:#f9fafb;font-size:11px;font-family:monospace">document.pdf<br><span style="color:#6b7280">application/pdf — 100% × 400</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;embed src=&quot;document.pdf&quot; type=&quot;application/pdf&quot; width=&quot;100%&quot; height=&quot;400&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>grid-auto-rows</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>embed { grid-auto-rows: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Everything EXCEPT the selector inside.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:lang(code)</code></li><li>B. <code>::first-letter</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:not(sel)</code></li><li>D. <code>.class</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6694">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6695 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6696">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6696" data-page="6696" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5819"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6696 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5819 — button × font-variant-caps</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">button</span> <span class="badge prop">font-variant-caps</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-variant-caps</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;button&gt;</code> — a clickable button: submit, reset, or script-triggered action. Control the style of capital letters.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;button&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="display:flex;gap:8px"><button style="background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:7px 16px;font-size:12px">Search (submit)</button><button style="background:#f3f4f6;color:#374151;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:7px 14px;font-size:12px">Clear (button)</button></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;form&gt; &lt;input name=&quot;q&quot; required&gt; &lt;button type=&quot;submit&quot;&gt;Search&lt;/button&gt; &lt;button type=&quot;button&quot; id=&quot;clear&quot;&gt;Clear&lt;/button&gt; &lt;/form&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font-variant-caps</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>button { font-variant-caps: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Parent selector! Matches if it CONTAINS the selector.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:has(sel)</code></li><li>B. <code>descendant (space)</code></li><li>C. <code>::placeholder</code></li><li>D. <code>[attr=value]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6695">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6696 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6697">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6697" data-page="6697" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5820"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6697 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5820 — fieldset × text-decoration</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">fieldset</span> <span class="badge prop">text-decoration</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-decoration</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;fieldset&gt;</code> — groups related form controls with a border and a &lt;legend&gt; caption. “Field required or not.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::before</code></li><li>B. <code>::file-selector-button</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:required / :optional</code></li><li>D. <code>[attr*=…]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6696">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6697 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6698">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6698" data-page="6698" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5821"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6698 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5821 — thead × widows</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">thead</span> <span class="badge prop">widows</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">widows</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;thead&gt;</code> — groups the header rows of a table. Minimum lines of a paragraph that must stay at the top of the next page.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;thead&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:11px;display:flex"><div style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f3f4f6;font-weight:700;padding:4px 10px">Name</div><div style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f3f4f6;font-weight:700;padding:4px 10px">Role</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;table&gt; &lt;thead&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;th&gt;Name&lt;/th&gt;&lt;th&gt;Role&lt;/th&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/thead&gt; &lt;tbody&gt;…&lt;/tbody&gt; &lt;/table&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>widows</b> = <b>integer</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>thead { widows: integer; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? Scroll behavior of the background (fixed = parallax-ish).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;center&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="text-align:center;font-size:13px;background:#f3f4f6;padding:6px">Centered via CSS, not &lt;center&gt;</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;center&gt;Centered text&lt;/center&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>background-attachment</b> = <b>fixed</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>center { background-attachment: fixed; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Element&#x27;s text direction matches.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:dir(dir)</code></li><li>B. <code>::marker</code></li><li>C. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>D. <code>:first-child</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6698">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6699 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6700">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6700" data-page="6700" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5823"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6700 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5823 — frame × mask-image</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">frame</span> <span class="badge prop">mask-image</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">mask-image</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;frame&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: frame (obsolete). Use <iframe> or real CSS layout.</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;frameset&gt;&lt;frame src=&quot;nav.html&quot;&gt;&lt;frame src=&quot;main.html&quot;&gt;&lt;/frameset&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>mask-image</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>frame { mask-image: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The NEXT sibling, immediately after.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::cue</code></li><li>B. <code>[attr$=…]</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>+</code></li><li>D. <code>:nth-child(n)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6699">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6700 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6701">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6701" data-page="6701" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5824"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6701 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5824 — dir × initial-letter</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dir</span> <span class="badge prop">initial-letter</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">initial-letter</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dir&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: directory list (obsolete). }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A thematic break between paragraphs (scene change, topic shift).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;hr&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;dl&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;tt&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;strong&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6745">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6746 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6747">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6747" data-page="6747" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5870"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6747 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5870 — bdo × list-style</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">bdo</span> <span class="badge prop">list-style</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">list-style</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;bdo&gt;</code> — forces the visual direction of text (use sparingly). stroke=&quot;#fff&quot; stroke-width=&quot;4&quot; fill=&quot;none&quot; stroke-linecap=&quot;round&quot; stroke-linejoin=&quot;round&quot;&gt;&lt;/path&gt; &lt;/svg&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>will-change</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>svg { will-change: auto; style=&quot;background:#eef2ff&quot;&gt;&lt;/colgroup&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>animation-delay</b> = <b>time</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>col { animation-delay: time; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “The point transforms rotate/scale around.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>outline</code></li><li>B. <code>font-weight</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>transform-origin</code></li><li>D. <code>isolation</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6842">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6843 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6844">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6844" data-page="6844" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5967"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6844 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5967 — font × scale</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">font</span> <span class="badge prop">scale</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">scale</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;font&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: font (obsolete). Independent scale (composes with transform).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;font&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="font-family:serif;color:#ef4444;font-size:13px">Legacy: <font> is dead — use CSS</span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;font face=&quot;Arial&quot; color=&quot;red&quot;&gt;text&lt;/font&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>scale</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>font { scale: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Independent rotate (composes with transform).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>float</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>rotate</code></li><li>C. <code>font-variant-caps</code></li><li>D. <code>clip-path</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6843">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6844 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6845">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6845" data-page="6845" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5968"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6845 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5968 — acronym × aspect-ratio</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">acronym</span> <span class="badge prop">aspect-ratio</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">aspect-ratio</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;acronym&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: acronym (obsolete). Locks the width:height ratio (16/9, 1/1, 4/3…).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;acronym&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="font-size:13px"><abbr title="World Wide Web" style="text-decoration:underline dotted;cursor:help">WWW</abbr> — use <abbr> now</span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;acronym title=&quot;World Wide Web&quot;&gt;WWW&lt;/acronym&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>aspect-ratio</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>acronym { aspect-ratio: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Move the element along an SVG path (motion path).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>offset-path</code></li><li>B. <code>top</code></li><li>C. <code>font-kerning</code></li><li>D. <code>list-style</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6844">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6845 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6846">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6846" data-page="6846" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5969"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6846 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5969 — nextid × padding-inline</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">nextid</span> <span class="badge prop">padding-inline</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">padding-inline</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;nextid&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: nextid (obsolete). Logical left+right padding (flips with direction).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;nextid&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;color:#9ca3af">No longer in the spec — just use links.</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;nextid href=&quot;part2.html&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding-inline</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>nextid { padding-inline: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches every element.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:focus</code></li><li>B. <code>:first-of-type</code></li><li>C. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>*</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6845">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6846 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6847">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6847" data-page="6847" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5970"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6847 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5970 — html × box-shadow</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">html</span> <span class="badge prop">box-shadow</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">box-shadow</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;html&gt;</code> — the root element of every html document. One or more shadows around the box.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;html&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;background:#f6f8fa;padding:10px;border:1px solid #d0d7de">&lt;html&gt; &rarr; &lt;head&gt; + &lt;body&gt;</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;html lang=&quot;en&quot;&gt; &lt;head&gt;...&lt;/head&gt; &lt;body&gt;...&lt;/body&gt; &lt;/html&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>box-shadow</b> = <b>multiple</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>html { box-shadow: multiple; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches by unique id.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>#id</code></li><li>B. <code>:first-child</code></li><li>C. <code>:not(sel)</code></li><li>D. <code>:target</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6846">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6847 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6848">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6848" data-page="6848" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5971"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6848 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5971 — script × overflow-wrap</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">script</span> <span class="badge prop">overflow-wrap</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">overflow-wrap</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;script&gt;</code> — embeds or references executable javascript. Break long words so they don&#x27;t overflow (break-word).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;script&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;background:#0d1117;color:#7ee787;padding:10px;border-radius:6px">console.log("hi"); → "hi"</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;script src=&quot;app.js&quot; defer&gt;&lt;/script&gt; &lt;script&gt; console.log(&quot;hi&quot;); &lt;/script&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>overflow-wrap</b> = <b>normal</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>script { overflow-wrap: normal; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The value starts with the string.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:nth-child(n)</code></li><li>B. <code>:has(sel)</code></li><li>C. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>[attr^=…]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6847">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6848 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6849">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6849" data-page="6849" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5972"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6849 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5972 — aside × align-content</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">aside</span> <span class="badge prop">align-content</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">align-content</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;aside&gt;</code> — content tangentially related to the main content (sidebar, box, pull quote). Distributes the flex LINES when items wrap (needs flex-wrap).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;aside&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="background:#fff3e0;border:1px solid #ffcc80;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;width:230px"><b style="font-size:12px">Did you know?</b><br><span style="font-size:12px">An <b>aside</b> box — related but optional.</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;aside&gt; &lt;h3&gt;Did you know?&lt;/h3&gt; &lt;p&gt;HTML5 added 40+ new elements.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/aside&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>align-content</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>aside { align-content: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches an element in a state.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:last-of-type</code></li><li>B. <code>:required / :optional</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:</code></li><li>D. <code>~</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6848">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6849 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6850">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6850" data-page="6850" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5973"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6850 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5973 — figcaption × grid-area</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">figcaption</span> <span class="badge prop">grid-area</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">grid-area</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;figcaption&gt;</code> — the caption for a &lt;figure&gt;. Places an item in a grid area (shorthand for row/column start+end).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;figcaption&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:11px;color:#6b7280;border-top:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding-top:4px;width:250px">Sunrise in Cairo — <i>the figcaption</i></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;figure&gt;&lt;img src=&quot;a.png&quot;&gt;&lt;figcaption&gt;Sunrise in Cairo&lt;/figcaption&gt;&lt;/figure&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>grid-area</b> = <b>name</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>figcaption { grid-area: name; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Focus via keyboard (not mouse click).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:focus-visible</code></li><li>B. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li><li>C. <code>:in-range / :out-of-range</code></li><li>D. <code>::first-letter</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6849">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6850 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6851">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6851" data-page="6851" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5974"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6851 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5974 — p × font-family</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">p</span> <span class="badge prop">font-family</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-family</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;p&gt;</code> — a block of text — the basic unit of written content. The typeface(s) to use, as a priority list.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;p&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6">A <b>&lt;p&gt;</b> is a paragraph. The browser adds vertical space around it automatically.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;This is a paragraph of text.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font-family</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>p { font-family: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Last child of its parent.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:last-child</code></li><li>B. <code>:checked</code></li><li>C. <code>:dir(dir)</code></li><li>D. <code>::placeholder</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6850">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6851 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6852">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6852" data-page="6852" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5975"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6852 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5975 — summary × word-spacing</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">summary</span> <span class="badge prop">word-spacing</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">word-spacing</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;summary&gt;</code> — the visible caption of a &lt;details&gt; disclosure. Extra space between words.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;summary&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px">Click ▸ <b>FAQ</b> to expand — <i>summary is the label</i></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;details&gt;&lt;summary&gt;FAQ&lt;/summary&gt;&lt;p&gt;Answer...&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/details&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>word-spacing</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>summary { word-spacing: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The n-th child OF ITS TAG type (ignores other tags).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:nth-of-type(n)</code></li><li>C. <code>+</code></li><li>D. <code>::file-selector-button</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6851">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6852 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6853">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6853" data-page="6853" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5976"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6853 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5976 — u × white-space</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">u</span> <span class="badge prop">white-space</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">white-space</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;u&gt;</code> — non-extractive information: a spell-check red line, a signature. How whitespace is handled: wrap, collapse, pre…</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;u&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">My name is <u>Ali</u>. — underlined, no meaning</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;My name is &lt;u&gt;Ali&lt;/u&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>white-space</b> = <b>normal</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>u { white-space: normal; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “No children at all (not even text).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:target</code></li><li>B. <code>::after</code></li><li>C. <code>element</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:empty</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6852">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6853 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6854">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6854" data-page="6854" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5977"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6854 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5977 — data × background-color</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">data</span> <span class="badge prop">background-color</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background-color</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;data&gt;</code> — a machine-readable value behind human-readable text. The solid background color.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;data&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Weight: <span title="85">85 kg</span> — value="85" is stored for machines</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Weight: &lt;data value=&quot;85&quot;&gt;85 kg&lt;/data&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>background-color</b> = <b>color</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>data { background-color: color; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Like :is but with ZERO specificity.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>::selection</code></li><li>C. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:where(sel, …)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6853">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6854 / 8000 · Practice 30</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6855">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6855" data-page="6855" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 5978"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 30</span><span>Page 6855 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 5978 — sub × print-color-adjust</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">sub</span> <span class="badge prop">print-color-adjust</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">print-color-adjust</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;sub&gt;</code> — subscript text (rendered below the baseline). Distance to the left of the element.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;bdi&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Hello <bdi dir="auto" style="background:#fef9c3;padding:0 4px;border-radius:3px">مرحبا</bdi> world — isolated, layout-safe</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Hello &lt;bdi dir=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;مرحبا&lt;/bdi&gt; world&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>margin-left</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>bdi { margin-left: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “Disables a form control: not clickable, not submitted, greyed by default.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>disabled</code></li><li>B. <code>name</code></li><li>C. <code>data-…</code></li><li>D. <code>is</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6891">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6892 / 8000 · Practice 31</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6893">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6893" data-page="6893" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6016"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 31</span><span>Page 6893 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6016 — dd × border-color</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dd</span> <span class="badge prop">border-color</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border-color</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dd&gt;</code> — the description (details) for a term in a description list. &lt;area shape=&quot;circle&quot; coords=&quot;150,60,30&quot; href=&quot;/lake&quot; alt=&quot;Lake&quot;&gt; &lt;/map&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>perspective</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>map { perspective: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Container for all machine-oriented information about the document.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;b&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;head&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;form&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;div&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6894">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6895 / 8000 · Practice 31</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6896">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6896" data-page="6896" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6019"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 31</span><span>Page 6896 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6019 — optgroup × flex</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">optgroup</span> <span class="badge prop">flex</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">flex</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;optgroup&gt;</code> — a labeled group of &lt;option&gt; &lt;optgroup label=&quot;Fruits&quot;&gt; &lt;option&gt;Apple&lt;/option&gt; &lt;option&gt;Banana&lt;/option&gt; &lt;/optgroup&gt; &lt;/select&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>flex</b> = <b>1</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>optgroup { flex: 1; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Links an external resource, most commonly a stylesheet.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;em&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;link&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;select&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;aside&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6895">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6896 / 8000 · Practice 31</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6897">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6897" data-page="6897" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6020"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 31</span><span>Page 6897 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6020 — table × grid-auto-rows</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">table</span> <span class="badge prop">grid-auto-rows</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">grid-auto-rows</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;table&gt;</code> — a two-dimensional table of data.
