Shorthand: line + style + color for underlines/overlines/strikethroughs.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;blink&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="font-size:13px;color:#9ca3af">Blink no longer exists — and blinking text hurts accessibility.</span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;blink&gt;Blinking&lt;/blink&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-decoration</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>blink { text-decoration: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A complete, independent piece of content that makes sense on its own.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;dfn&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;table&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;article&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;h2&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6898">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6899 / 8000 · Practice 31</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6900">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6900" data-page="6900" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6023"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 31</span><span>Page 6900 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6023 — applet × widows</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">applet</span> <span class="badge prop">widows</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">widows</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;applet&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: applet (obsolete). Minimum lines of a paragraph that must stay at the top of the next page.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;applet&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;color:#9ca3af">Java applets: extinct. Games are now <canvas>/WebGL/JS.</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;applet code=&quot;Game.class&quot; width=200 height=100&gt;&lt;/applet&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>widows</b> = <b>integer</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>applet { widows: integer; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Introductory content or a set of navigational links for a section or page.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;samp&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;col&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;header&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;h5&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6899">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6900 / 8000 · Practice 31</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6901">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6901" data-page="6901" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6024"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 31</span><span>Page 6901 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6024 — a × background-attachment</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">a</span> <span class="badge prop">background-attachment</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background-attachment</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;a&gt;</code> — creates a hyperlink to a page, a section, a file, an email, or a phone number. Changes the visual order of an item (without touching HTML).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;html&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;background:#f6f8fa;padding:10px;border:1px solid #d0d7de">&lt;html&gt; &rarr; &lt;head&gt; + &lt;body&gt;</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;html lang=&quot;en&quot;&gt; &lt;head&gt;...&lt;/head&gt; &lt;body&gt;...&lt;/body&gt; &lt;/html&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>order</b> = <b>integer</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>html { order: integer; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Aligns inline content to the baseline (icons with text!).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>counter-reset</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>vertical-align</code></li><li>C. <code>max-height</code></li><li>D. <code>align-content</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6973">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6974 / 8000 · Practice 31</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6975">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6975" data-page="6975" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6098"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 31</span><span>Page 6975 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6098 — script × place-self</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">script</span> <span class="badge prop">place-self</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">place-self</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;script&gt;</code> — embeds or references executable javascript. Shorthand: align-self + justify-self (one item).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;script&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;background:#0d1117;color:#7ee787;padding:10px;border-radius:6px">console.log("hi"); → "hi"</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;script src=&quot;app.js&quot; defer&gt;&lt;/script&gt; &lt;script&gt; console.log(&quot;hi&quot;); &lt;/script&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>place-self</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>script { place-self: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Automatic hyphenation of long words.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>quotes</code></li><li>B. <code>margin</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>hyphens</code></li><li>D. <code>flex-shrink</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6974">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6975 / 8000 · Practice 31</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6976">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6976" data-page="6976" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6099"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 31</span><span>Page 6976 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6099 — aside × font-optical-sizing</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">aside</span> <span class="badge prop">font-optical-sizing</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-optical-sizing</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;aside&gt;</code> — content tangentially related to the main content (sidebar, box, pull quote). Whether the element can be dragged (legacy, mostly images).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;sub&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">H<sub>2</sub>O and x<sub>1</sub></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;H&lt;sub&gt;2&lt;/sub&gt;O and x&lt;sub&gt;1&lt;/sub&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>user-drag</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>sub { user-drag: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “The accent color of form controls (checkboxes, radios, ranges, progress).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>transition-property</code></li><li>B. <code>border-collapse</code></li><li>C. <code>justify-self</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>accent-color</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6981">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6982 / 8000 · Practice 31</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6983">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6983" data-page="6983" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6106"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 31</span><span>Page 6983 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6106 — ul × animation-direction</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">ul</span> <span class="badge prop">animation-direction</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">animation-direction</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;ul&gt;</code> — a bulleted list of items. Forward / reverse / alternate playback.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;ul&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><ul style="font-size:13px;margin:0;padding-left:22px;line-height:1.7"><li>HTML</li><li>CSS</li><li>JavaScript</li></ul></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ul&gt; &lt;li&gt;HTML&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;CSS&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;JavaScript&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>animation-direction</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>ul { animation-direction: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Keep background colors when printing (-webkit-print-color-adjust).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>transition-delay</code></li><li>B. <code>outline-offset</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>print-color-adjust</code></li><li>D. <code>font-size</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p6982">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 6983 / 8000 · Practice 31</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p6984">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p6984" data-page="6984" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6107"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 31</span><span>Page 6984 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6107 — picture × offset-path</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">picture</span> <span class="badge prop">offset-path</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">offset-path</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;picture&gt;</code> — wraps multiple &lt;source&gt; candidates to serve the right image per condition. } if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft'){ var p = document.querySelector('a[data-nav="prev"]'); if(p) p.click(); } }); // jump (every page has one) var boxes = document.querySelectorAll('.jump-input'); for(var bi = 0; bi < boxes.length; bi++){ (function(box){ box.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key !== 'Enter') return; var n = parseInt(box.value, 10); if(!n || n < 1 || n > 8000){ box.value=''; box.placeholder='1–8000'; return; } var vol = Math.ceil(n / 500); location.href = 'vol-' + String(vol).padStart(2, '0') + '.html' + '#p' + n; }); })(boxes[bi]); } })(); </script> </body> </html>
